name: Skills Lab lists the seeded skills and previews one
description: Loads /skills, filters the list to the seeded pr-quality-rubric and selects it (the URL becomes /skills/:id while the list stays on screen), and walks Config → Preview → Versions. Confirms the list card, the body editor header (filename + token estimate), the rendered preview, and the seeded v1 snapshot. Read-only seeded data — no import, no model call. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).

steps.label: card shows the derived agent count
filter the list so the card is on screen without scrolling
selection lives in the path: /skills/:id, list still beside it
body editor names the skill file
preview tab is active in the URL

cmd: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
steps.label: preview explains what it shows
the skill body is rendered as markdown
the live version is marked current
the seeded v1 snapshot carries its note
